modes.text: Search your library for a creature or land card and reveal it. Put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land card. Otherwise, put it into your hand. Then shuffle.

do.reason: One search whose destination depends on the card found: onto the battlefield tapped if it is a land card, otherwise into the hand. Search has a single 'to' (and 'othersTo' only for further cards of the same search), so a type-conditional destination for the one card found cannot be said; putting it into the hand and then moving a land to the battlefield would be a different sequence of zone changes.
